title: A Haar-random rotation of a plane and a unit direction avoids Bad (Steps 5–6 for one plane)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, E := ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), and let 𝓛 := E →L[ℝ] E carry the Borel σ-algebra of its norm topology. Write g* for the adjoint, Hⁿ := μHE[n] and P_W := W.starProjection. Let Bad ⊆ E × 𝓛 × E be measurable and a ∈ E. Assume that for every (n+1)-dimensional subspace H ⊆ E, Hⁿ({x ∈ H : |x| = 1, (a, P_H, x) ∈ Bad}) = 0. Let θ be a Borel probability measure on 𝓛 with g*g = 1 for θ-a.e. g, such that the image of θ under g ↦ gk equals θ for every k ∈ 𝓛 with k*k = 1. Let V ⊆ E be a subspace of dimension n + 1 with 0 < Hⁿ({x ∈ V : |x| = 1}) < ∞, and let ζ ∈ V with |ζ| = 1. Then θ({g ∈ 𝓛 : (a, g P_V g*, gζ) ∈ Bad}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (Bad : Set (Rn N × (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N) × Rn N)), MeasurableSet Bad → ∀ a : Rn N, (∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → μHE[n] {x | x ∈ H ∧ ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ (a, H.starProjection, x) ∈ Bad} = 0) → ∀ θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1) → (∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ V : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ V = n + 1 → 0 < μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} → μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} < ∞ → ∀ ζ ∈ V, ‖ζ‖ = 1 → θ {g | (a, g * V.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g, g ζ) ∈ Bad} = 0
